NVR_2008_p76__paragraph_1.ocr:
(a) 
The Company, as borrower, has available an unsecured working capital revolving credit facility 
(the “Facility”).  The Facility provides for borrowings of up to $600,000, subject to certain borrowing 
base limitations.  The Facility is generally available to fund working capital needs of NVR’s 
homebuilding segment.  Up to $150,000 of the Facility is currently available for issuance in the form of 
letters of credit, of which $13,421 and $17,199 were outstanding at December 31, 2008 and 2007, 
respectively.  The Facility expires in December 2010, and outstanding amounts bear interest at either (i) 
the prime rate or (ii) the London Interbank Offering Rate (“LIBOR”) plus Applicable Margin as defined 
within the Facility.  There were no borrowings under the Facility during 2008 and 2007.  At December 
31, 2008, there were no borrowing base limitations reducing the amount available to the Company for 
borrowings.

NVR_2008_p76__paragraph_2.ocr:
